test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following is the odd one out? These options represent sets of numbers following a particular property.

Identify the set that does NOT follow the rule.
solution:
Given Option:

1) 1, 3, 5

 
• 1 is not prime
 
• 3 and 5 are prime

→ Mixed set

2) 9, 15, 21

 
• 9 = composite
 
• 15 = composite

21 = composite**
→ All composite

3) 13, 17, 19

 
• All prime

4) 29, 31, 37

 
• All prime

 

Since only one set contains all composite numbers, it is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**
